medications from Patient Medication Order child table --#} {%- set _doc_name = doc.name | string -%} {%- set med_orders = frappe.db.get_all("Patient Medication Order", filters=[["discharge_id", "=", entries -%} {%- if meds.append(entry) -%}{%- endif -%} {%- endfor -%} {%- endfor -%}
